_comment: Class-4 wire-level regression probes — the engine-stage half of the regression hunt (the text-stage half is bin/check_regressions.py). Each row is a request the future engine must answer as stated; until an engine exists these bind the CONTRACT TEXT: executing 'against the text' means deriving, from the final text alone, what the engine must answer — a probe the text cannot decide is itself a finding (underspecification). Fixture vault: fixtures/walkvault/; workspace states: fixtures/wsfix/.

probes.law: mint plane is per-segment BYTE-EQUALITY — lowercase 'b' must NOT match '# B'; case-insensitivity lives only in the walk plane
probes.kills: the exact team-h death: a case-folded spelling reaching the mint surface

probes.law: duplicate block id: mint plane refuses LOUD while the walk plane stays app-silent (WX-5 pair)
probes.kills: silent-last-wins minting — team-h's second UC-R9 breach

probes.law: occurrence index makes duplicates exactly addressable on the mint plane — the loud alternative to silent picking
probes.kills: contracts that refuse duplicates without offering an exact address (unusable strictness)

probes.law: the walk-plane response type has NO rev field — mint partition as a type-level fact
probes.kills: any resolve output that can be replayed as a CAS token

probes.law: write targets speak the strict grammar ONLY (hpath/anchor/fm_key); raw linktext in a splice target is not a form
probes.kills: any path where a walked ref arms a write (W2 proper)

probes.law: strict server: unknown request fields reject loudly; no client span field exists — offsets on the wire request are unrepresentable
probes.kills: decision-007 breach: byte offsets sneaking back into requests

expect.note: NO if_node_rev, NO if_root, NO actor, NO now — must succeed at the wire (state s0)

probes.law: decision 007: requests never require revs; guardless splices are legal wire frames forever (mandatoriness = Go ratchet, never wire law)
probes.kills: safety ceremony reappearing as wire-level requiredness

expect.note: kind name per final text's extract enum; post-011 charset is [A-Za-z0-9-]+ both planes — advertise-nothing-resolve-nothing (W3 identity): extract emits ⇔ resolve resolves

probes.law: decision 011: a '_'-bearing id is charset-invalid; the mint plane must not advertise what the walk plane cannot resolve
probes.kills: two-plane charset residue surviving the veto

request._check: GT provenance, not a wire frame

probes.law: B3: ground truth is regenerated FROM the final contract; resolution GT comes from the live app oracle, never hand-frozen fixtures, never a rejected dialect's lane pack
probes.kills: GT gating the engine against a dialect the tournament rejected
